messages.text: Good morning cohort! Today: Special Enrollment Periods (SEPs) and how to explain APTC to callers. Slides are pinned.
Quick q - is losing employer coverage a qualifying life event even if the person quit voluntarily?
Yes. Loss of minimum essential coverage qualifies regardless of why the job ended. They generally have 60 days from the loss to enroll.
What's the easiest way to explain APTC to someone who's never heard of it?
I say: it's a tax credit paid in advance straight to your insurer every month, so your premium bill is lower now instead of waiting for your tax refund.
Caller today asked why her plan changed from Silver to Bronze after auto-renew. I escalated but not sure that was right.
Good instinct. Plan crosswalk on auto-renew can map to a different metal level if the old plan was discontinued. Check the renewal notice first, then escalate if it doesn't match.
Heads up I had a caller member ID HS-5520931 DOB 02/17/1979 asking whether her insulin is covered on the new plan, where do I send that?

messages.text: Reminder: please don't post member identifiers in channel - use the ticket number only. Formulary questions go to the carrier's pharmacy line.
Is the income verification DMI due in 90 days or 95?
90 days from the notice for income data matching issues. Always check the date on the consumer's notice though.
Shared the updated SEP cheat sheet in the drive. Let me know if anything's off.
